The subject is carrier checks
Carrier checks for traveling pets

Travelers should review carrier checks before arrival so the journey starts smoothly and your companion is set for safe acceptance at Aurelia Skyways. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk is ready to help with comfort, fit, and handling guidance for different species and temperaments.

Please make sure the carrier matches the stated travel needs and is in good condition for the trip. <<FACT F068>> Keep the space secure, calm, and easy for staff to inspect, and bring any care items that support your pet's comfort.

For birds, <<FACT F065>> The passenger coordinator can explain the required travel steps, and the senior coordinator reviews any special concerns with care and consistency.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel so we can help you prepare with confidence.
